newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault 96 net loss seen 4-5 bln Ffr-paper.
newsitem.headline: Renault 96 net loss seen 4-5 bln Ffr-paper.

text.p: French car maker Renault SA could post a net loss for 1996 of between four and five billion francs taking into account restructuring costs, financial daily Les Echos, quoting a company source, reported on Wednesday.
The final net loss would be between "four and five billion francs", the paper quoted the source as saying.

Les Echos said analysts had already revised up their expectations for 1996 losses to between two and 2.5 billion francs after the company said on February 15 its operating profit would be higher than expected by the market.
The results are due to be released on March 20.
